Root construction, 29 October 2026. Authored investigation; actual reviews and corrections are recorded separately. The new bridge here is a **single normalized causal reference with the complete returning memory**, constructed without a future-dependent polar normalization. Physical control acquisition and renewal remain separate interfaces.

## 1. Consequence and choice of attack

The completed postrecord comparison supplies a regular logical isometry even when physical postmeasurement moments diverge. Its final normalization is on the original input of a fixed programme and can reweight earlier records. It does not supply one causal ideal process under arbitrary future interventions.

Measurement-free hybrid gate teleportation and periodic Pauli controls are strong conventional alternatives, not discoveries claimed here. We ask a deeper question: can the local protected algebra be completed into a genuine causal noise dynamics while universal physical controls act only on the logical factor throughout every finite protected history?

We construct such a completion at a qualified finite-lifetime interface. Smoothly modify **comparison** differential operators near syndrome boundaries. They generate a normalized gauge-memory evolution on a torus. Every finite history from the protected compact core agrees with the physical dynamics. Two finite actual-suffix remainders then compare the physical process with this fixed causal process. No boundary is physically modified, no filtering is applied, and no bath is reset.

This supports a coherent universal computation window without per-gate syndrome deformation, magic supply or detector feedback. It does not imply that the required periodic nonlinear couplings are cheap or already acquired. The aim is a causal foundation and an explicit control target, not a threshold claim.

# Finite harmonic controls with a global comparison

Root construction, 29 October 2026. The companion conventional author supplied the monotone polynomial/Fourier formulas independently. Root introduced the nearby exact smooth extension and its use as a global bounded perturbation of the causal-completion model. Reviews remain separately scoped.

## 1. Why changing the comparison helps

The ideal smooth periodic plateau in [CAUSAL_BOUNDARY_COMPLETION.md](CAUSAL_BOUNDARY_COMPLETION.md) is not a finite trigonometric polynomial. An analytic finite sum cannot equal a nonconstant plateau on an open interval. Using its small on-band error as if it also controlled arbitrarily many derivatives would be invalid.

Instead construct a finite physical Hamiltonian and a nearby smooth exact reference. Their difference is bounded in **global** operator norm. Its effect can be charged once along the full dynamics, with the unbounded background noise retained. The derivative constants of the physical approximation do not enter the finite polynomial remainder.

## 2. Explicit finite control

For integer r>=0 set

    C_r=(2r+1) binom(2r,r)/4^r,
    P_r(s)=C_r integral_0^s (1-t^2)^r dt,
    g_r(x)=P_r(cos(Lx)),   L=sqrt(pi).                       (1)

P_r is odd, monotone, bounded by one on [-1,1], and P_r(1)=1. Its degree is 2r+1. Differentiating g_r gives -L C_r sin(Lx)^(2r+1), whose finite sine series integrates to

    g_r(x)=sum_(j=0)^r A_(r,j)cos((2j+1)Lx),
    A_(r,j)=(-1)^j C_r binom(2r+1,r-j)/(4^r(2j+1)).        (2)

For 0<c<1,

    sup_(|s|>=c)|P_r(s)-sign(s)|
       <= C_r(1-c^2)^(r+1)/(2c(r+1))
       <= c^(-1)(1-c^2)^(r+1).                            (3)

The first bound follows from

    integral_c^1(1-t^2)^r dt
       <= c^(-1)integral_c^1 t(1-t^2)^r dt.

The second uses C_r<=2r+1. No floating approximation is needed for the coefficients.

## 3. Nearby exact extension

Fix protected support a<a_0<a_1<L/2 and c_i=cos(La_i). Choose smooth even zeta(s) in [0,1], zero on |s|<=c_1, one on |s|>=c_0. Define

    f_r(x)=g_r(x)+zeta(cos Lx)[sign(cos Lx)-g_r(x)].         (4)

Zeta vanishes in a neighborhood of the sign discontinuities, so f_r is smooth. Convex interpolation proves |f_r|<=1. Oddness of P_r and evenness of zeta prove f_r(x+L)=-f_r(x). It is exactly (-1)^m for |x-mL|<=a_0. The only place f_r differs from g_r has |cos Lx|>=c_1; hence

    ||f_r-g_r||_infinit

Author: architecture challenge branch, 29 October 2026. This is new work; no predecessor is edited or re-reviewed. The root's native-control and causal-boundary constructions are separate subjects and are not independently validated here.

## 1. Scientific disposition

A coherent spin and conditional displacements can approximate a nonlinear periodic phase with its complete workspace returned approximately clean. Section 4 gives a fully specified, conservative finite circuit, uniform over the oscillator spectrum and all external references. It is an existence construction, not a competitive precision compiler: QSP is the stronger conventional compilation machinery when its signal access and synthesized phase list are supplied.

The decisive limitation is different. Exact cleanup of a bare controller does not certify fault containment. Section 2 constructs a finite-duration, bounded, coherent ancilla–memory coupling whose effect becomes a logical–memory interaction even after perfect cleanup. Angle slicing, fresh ancillas, and exact final reset do not suppress this channel at fixed total exposure. Conversely, native periodic control also has a direct logical fault channel when its coefficient fluctuates. Neither architecture acquires reliable control merely by removing measurements.

Section 3 supplies a useful exact boundary: a finite sequence of same-quadrature conditional-displacement queries and finite-dimensional ancillary rotations cannot implement a non-affine scalar phase while returning its workspace exactly to a fixed state on an open position interval. Approximation, noncommuting quadratures, additional physical nonlinearities, and different output interfaces remain available. This is a finite exponential-polynomial argument, not a no-go for approximate GKP computation or for general coherent control.
